# Miguel Gisbert — Full-Stack Software Engineer (Freelance)

> Freelance full-stack engineer based in Catalonia (CET), working remotely with teams in the United States and the United Kingdom. 10+ years shipping web, mobile and AI products with React, TypeScript, Node.js and Python — from architecture and APIs to CI/CD and monitoring. Contact: info@miguelgisbert.dev

## Case studies

- [CragXchange](https://miguelgisbert.dev/en/work/cragxchange): Global rock-climbing community platform with interactive crag map and native iOS/Android apps — React, React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL
- [Bluecode](https://miguelgisbert.dev/en/work/bluecode): Website for a software agency, designed for easy maintenance — React, TypeScript
- [Lifonet](https://miguelgisbert.dev/en/work/lifonet): Real-time waste collection tracking platform for operators and residents — React, Node.js
- [Laia Bobe](https://miguelgisbert.dev/en/work/laiabobe): Personal brand website for a coach and wellbeing specialist — React
- [Agrovolt](https://miguelgisbert.dev/en/work/agrovolt): Mobile app for a solar energy and agri-tech platform — React Native, iOS and Android
- [LegalPyme](https://miguelgisbert.dev/en/work/legalpyme): Document management and working-hours platform for small businesses — React, Node.js, PostgreSQL
